summary: Explore our GIS in Land Resource Management and Administration Course. Gain essential skills to effectively manage land resources using advanced GIS techniques.
lede: GIS in land management brings parcel records, survey data and land-use information into a spatial system for assessment and administration. It supports cadastral GIS specialists, land administration officers, planners and surveyors in managing land records through spatial database design, boundary gap and overlap checks, and land suitability analysis.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the technical and strategic oversight of land assets and administrative systems.
modules: Land Administration Foundations and LADM Standards
Spatial Data Acquisition and Geodetic Foundations
Spatial Database Management for Land Records
Land Use Planning and Suitability Analysis
Spatial Land Valuation and Taxation Modeling
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic GIS concepts and experience with either ArcGIS Pro or QGIS. Familiarity with land surveying principles or land law is recommended but not required. No prior programming experience is necessary, though basic SQL exposure is beneficial for the database module.
